rule.statement: A Divisional Secretary's determination under Section 10(1)(a) of the Act disposes the need to resort to Section 10(1)(b) of the Act.
rule.supporting_quote: Compliance with Section 10(2) did not arise since reference was not requested by the parties and a determination under Section 10(1)(a) had already been made which disposes the need to resort to Section 10(1)(b) of the Act.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 10(1)(a) of the Act, Section 10(2) of the Act, Section 10(1)(b) of the Act, Section 10(3) of the Act, Section 33 of the Act
